description: Pignet lexical search relevance corpus (VNEXT E4.3). Expert-graded CI fixture: each case has one grade-2 (most relevant) document, grade-1 (partially relevant) and grade-0 (irrelevant) documents. Grades reflect endpoint role for the query, not token overlap: same-term-different-domain documents are grade 0. Query types span single-term, multi-term, AND-operator and filtered cases; document types span agents, services and tools; scale cases carry 40-96 documents.
